codeReview.summary: The Scheduler migration is feature-complete against the contract: global paused/running state with pause/resume control, add-job form (id/agent/schedule/message/enabled), jobs table with enable/disable and delete actions, refresh, and operation feedback. The Playwright scheduler spec added in the same commit covers the required CRUD and global control flows with API mocks, and no blocking regressions were identified in reviewed source changes.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The frontend-worker skill still contains conflicting test guidance during migration milestones: Step 5 mandates full-suite Playwright, while mission guidance allows scoped page specs due known unrelated failures. This mismatch can trigger unnecessary procedure-deviation flags.
